reason: The user accepted the restored local 1.0.123 runtime and explicitly requested the same complete restart from a menu button.
decision: Add an explicit full-restart command to the existing runtime controller and both tray menus. Run its lifecycle worker in a separate transient user unit. Reuse the current desktop selection, layout restoration and managed IME helpers. Ordinary restart, channel changes and daemon-only controls retain their existing semantics.
guard_change: None. Existing quick-restart source and behavioral guards remain required. The separate explicit worker is allowed to restart IBus only when the IME backend is selected.
not_tested: No new browser matrix or native KDE acceptance is implied by lifecycle/source checks. The user's local 1.0.123 acceptance remains separate.
verification: Source and live/diagnostic receipts, exact measured scope and remaining gates are recorded in docs/development/full-restart-2026-11-02.md.
